definitions.explanation: The property of an organism or process that requires oxygen to live or function, as with aerobic bacteria. A biology and microbiology term, the opposite of {嫌気性|けんきせい} (anaerobic).

examples.japanese: {好気性|こうきせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{好気性|こうきせい}⟦{微生物|びせいぶつ}→微生物：12665_biseibutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: This treatment makes use of aerobic microorganisms.

examples.japanese: {好気性|こうきせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{生|い}きられない→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。
examples.english: Aerobic organisms cannot survive without oxygen.

notes:
Formed from {好気|こうき} (oxygen-favoring) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (-ic; nature/property). Used attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, as in {好気性|こうきせい}⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧ (aerobic bacteria).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好気性|こうきせい}⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧: aerobic bacteria
- {好気性|こうきせい}⟦{微生物|びせいぶつ}→微生物：12665_biseibutsu⟧: aerobic microorganisms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{嫌気性|けんきせい}→嫌気性：27751_kenkisei⟧: anaerobic — the opposite; not requiring (or harmed by) oxygen.
